comparator.sourceNotes: Radboud presents 60 EC in each of three years. Year 1 contains twelve compulsory 5-EC courses; its two 0-EC academic support activities do not count toward the 180 EC. Year 2 contains three 5-EC required courses, a 15-EC German-speaking-country stay within the major, and 30 EC of minor space. Year 3 contains four 5-EC required courses, a 10-EC independent bachelor thesis/tutorial, and 30 EC of restricted minor space (two Humanities minors or the educational minor). The educational minor is an optional route, not a required qualification. Prospectus year pages are indicative and do not establish a guaranteed 2028–2029 year-three timetable for a Fall 2026 entrant.

programmes.label: German Language and Culture at Radboud University

exception.reason: German-language proficiency, German linguistics and literature, German-speaking-country immersion and Dutch–German cultural exchange form the core of this bachelor. UCR currently offers no German-language course or specialist German-studies sequence. Related courses in general literature, history, communication and European politics cannot form a credible 24-course closest-match programme without treating them as substitutes for missing German-language study.
exception.curriculumContext: Radboud’s currently published year-specific prospectus pages are indicative; the year-three page is labelled 2029–2030, and the precise future curriculum for a Fall 2026 entrant is not guaranteed.
exception.ucrCourseEvidence: Checked data/reference/ucr_courses_enriched.xlsx on GitHub main (151 UCR course rows), including course names, descriptions, profiles, planned semesters and prerequisites. It contains general literature, linguistics via Psycholinguistics, history, communication and European politics, but no German-language course, German-specific literature or linguistics sequence, or German-speaking-country immersion. Those related courses cannot support a defensible 24-course closest match.
